title: 2 Timothy Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on 2 Timothy 1: the greeting to Timothy, the faith of Lois and Eunice, the spirit God gave, and the house of Onesiphorus.

questions.text: How does Paul describe himself in the opening verse?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says Paul is an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God.

questions.text: To whom is this letter written?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 addresses the letter to Timothy, called "my beloved child".

questions.text: In whom did the sincere faith that is in Timothy live first?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says the sincere faith lived first in his grandmother Lois, and then in his mother Eunice.

questions.text: How does Paul say the gift of God came to be in Timothy?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says Timothy should stir up the gift of God which is in him through the laying on of Paul's hands.

answers.text: By a word from the prophets
By the prayers of the elders
Through the laying on of his hands

questions.text: What kind of spirit does the text say God gave us?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says God did not give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love and self-control.

answers.text: A spirit of power, love and self-control
A spirit of wisdom and of riches
A spirit of silence and of waiting

questions.text: What is Timothy told not to be ashamed of?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says he should not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of Paul his prisoner, but should endure hardship for the Good News.

answers.text: The city where he was born

questions.text: What did our Savior, Christ Jesus, abolish according to verse 10?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says that at the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, he abolished death and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.

questions.text: Paul says he was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of whom?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says he was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

questions.text: Which two men are named among all those in Asia who turned away from Paul?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says that all who are in Asia turned away from him, and names Phygelus and Hermogenes.

questions.text: Who often refreshed Paul and sought him diligently when he was in Rome?
questions.explanation: Verses 16 and 17 say that Onesiphorus often refreshed Paul, was not ashamed of his chain, and sought him diligently in Rome until he found him.
